Option A — Thu 5 Nov, 10:00–10:30 PT (Marissa + Ben, Redwood SE)
Option B — Fri 6 Nov, 08:30–09:00 PT (Marissa + Ben, Redwood SE)

- 10m: next steps, data access checklist, timeline
